test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If Ram walks at a speed of 8 km/h, he misses a train by 7 minutes. However, if he walks at a speed of 10 km/h, he reaches the station 5 minutes before the departure of the train. Find the distance (in km) between Ram’s house and the station.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance = [(S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₂ − S₁)] × Total Time Difference

S₁ = 8 km/h, S₂ = 10 km/h, Time Difference = 7 + 5 = 12 mins = 1 / 5 hr.

Distance = [(8 × 10) ÷ (10 − 8)] × (1 / 5)

Distance = (80 ÷ 2) × (1 / 5) = 40 × (1 / 5) = 8 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c48823f556e4b4d5b545872dda73540ba07b7332a9ac0243693f660cf6a4c7c.png] 

**Given:**

Speed of Ram on day 1 (S₁) = 8 km/h, time late = 7 minutes.

Speed of Ram on day 2 (S₂) = 10 km/h, time early = 5 minutes.

Total time difference = 7 + 5 = 12 minutes.

Time difference in hours = 12 / 60 = 1 / 5 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the distance between Ram's house and the station be D km.

⇒ Time taken at 8 km/h = D / 8 hours

⇒ Time taken at 10 km/h = D / 10 hours

⇒ Difference in time = 1 / 5 hours

⇒ (D / 8) − (D / 10) = 1 / 5

⇒ (5D − 4D) / 40 = 1 / 5

⇒ D / 40 = 1 / 5

⇒ D = 40 / 5

⇒ D = 8 km

**∴ The correct answer is 8 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Distance Rule

When the distance is constant, the ratio of speeds is inversely proportional to the ratio of times taken. If the speed ratio is a : b, then the time ratio will be b : a.

Average Speed

If a certain distance is covered at speed x and the same distance is covered at speed y, the average speed for the whole journey is calculated as (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds. When moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds.
